hints.title: Count Element Frequencies
hints.text: Count how many times each number appears in the array.

hints.title: Lucky Integer Condition
hints.text: An integer is lucky if its value equals its frequency count in the array.

hints.title: Find Maximum Lucky Value
hints.text: Find all integers where count equals value and return the maximum one. Return -1 if no lucky integer exists.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting frequency repeatedly for each element takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single frequency pass allows O(1) checks per unique number.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate builds frequency table and tracks maximum key matching its count.
complexity.notes: Returns -1 if no lucky number is found.
